I know these folks. This is Newark. I have been lifted for decades by everyday people who show leadership, step up, and give strength to others. 

May we encounter more of that. 
May we be more of that.

Delaney Hall must close. This nightmare needs to end now. 

I’ve seen it with my own eyes — a prison profiting off human pain while ripping mothers from their American newborn babies and denying them basic medical care. 

This is a moral stain on our community and our nation.

I love this young man, obviously influenced by who he is dressing up like. 

We all make a difference in more ways than we know. 

People are watching, and they take note of how we live, how we love, and how we give. 

May we strive each day to lead by example, showing up as our best selves, extending grace, and offering mercy. May our lives help, heal, and serve others… and perhaps even inspire others to do the same.

No president gets to weaponize the government against the women who stand up to him. Trump lost in court, so now he’s using taxpayer money, and the people who are supposed to keep us safe, to persecute his victim all over again.

Trump’s slush fund isn’t just corruption, it's taking Congress’ constitutional power to reward those who beat police officers on January 6th. 

Every American should be standing up and speaking out to defend our constitution and end this corruption.

Video

This got me. 

I'm reminded of the quote:

"If you have come here to help me, you are wasting your time. But if you have come because your liberation is bound up with mine, then let us work together.”

May we free ourselves in service of others.

This election won’t be about left and right, it will be about right and wrong.

For 250 years Americans have stood up and spoke up against the powerful, we have to do the same this November and hold President Trump accountable.

The boss is speaking truth to power – calling out the nightmare at Delaney Hall. He’s shining a light on the suffering in this for-profit facility and Trump’s cruelty that’s tearing families apart.

I‘ve met these detainees–our neighbors, small business owners, high school athletes. I met the mother ripped from her newborn American baby, denied proper medical care.

This is a moral stain on our nation.

@usatodayentertainment

Trump wants his face on your money. On your passport. On your national park pass. 

This was never about you. 
It was always about him.

The elections this November are a moral moment in America.

We need a Congress that will hold Trump accountable and deliver for the American people.
